stories.summary: India's steel demand is projected to reach 250 to 280 million tonnes per annum by 2035, according to a McKinsey report. stories.title: EY report highlights pharma GCC growth
stories.summary: Global capability centres in India's pharma sector generate 10.5 billion dollars in gross value added and employ 120,000 professionals, according to a report by EY and the Organisation of Pharmaceutical Producers of India. Most top biopharma companies now operate such centres in the country.

stories.title: Consulting firms lead IIM Ahmedabad summer placements
stories.summary: Accenture, BCG, McKinsey, Alvarez and Marsal, Bain and Company, and Kearney were among the top recruiters for the IIM Ahmedabad PGP Class of 2028. All 414 students secured placements across 27 cohorts. Over 55 new companies participated in the process this year. The consulting sector remains a consistent destination.

stories.title: IIM Ahmedabad places 414 students in summer roles
stories.summary: IIM Ahmedabad has placed 414 students from its PGP Class of 2028 in summer roles for the 2026-27 academic year. Consulting firms accounted for 191 offers, representing 46 percent of the total placements. More than 160 companies participated in the process, offering over 230 roles to the cohort.
